entry.title: Θάνατος Μαζωνάκη: Απολογούνται σήμερα οι δύο κατηγορούμενοι γιατροί
entry.summary: The two doctors charged over Giorgos Mazonakis's death give their pleas to the magistrate today, now facing homicide with possible intent, which carries a life sentence. The forensic report, drawn from the plasmapheresis machine's log, shows the first alarm ('Alarm 9', venous pressure exceeding the limit) came just 11 minutes after treatment began, the procedure continued despite repeated alarms, and the ambulance service was called almost two hours later.

entry.title: Ο Τραμπ βλέπει «αρρωστημένη συνωμοσία» κατά της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης
entry.summary: Donald Trump rejected in six angry posts the calls by AI leaders for stricter regulation and a global slowdown, speaking of a 'sick conspiracy' and branding fears of losing control a 'HOAX', like 'climate change'. He phoned Nvidia's Jensen Huang, who put the call on speaker at a conference, to declare that 'robots are not going to take over', placing supremacy over China above public concerns.

entry.title: «Θέλω να μάθω πώς πέθανε το παιδί μου, τι προκάλεσε τη φωτιά» – Σε εξέλιξη οι καταθέσεις συγγενών θυμάτων
entry.summary: At the Tempi trial in Larissa the relatives of Francesca Beza testified; she survived the collision but died in the fire, as captured in the audio where she says 'I have no oxygen'. Her father complained that the case file does not state the cause of death of those burned, her brother demanded scientific investigation of the fireball and the 'backfilling' of the site, and her mother said 'if it weren't for the fire, she would be here'.

entry.title: Θάνατος Μαζωνάκη: Δόκτωρ με πτυχίο από τη Χονολουλού
entry.summary: A Kathimerini investigation into the CV of Giorgos Mazonakis's doctor: the 'master's in Quantum Medicine from the University of Hawaii' cannot be found at the public university but points to Quantum University in Honolulu, an unaccredited private online platform for alternative medicine where Gregg Braden teaches. Its founder, Paul Drouin, was found guilty in 1997 by Quebec's College of Physicians of using unrecognised diagnostic techniques, while the IKPI institute, which hosted her as a speaker in 2023, says it could not vet speakers' CVs.

entry.title: Ζελένσκι: Σταματούμε τα πλήγματα στη Ρωσία αν η Μόσχα πάψει να πλήττει τις υποδομές μας
entry.summary: Zelensky said Ukraine is ready to halt strikes on Russian territory if allies secure a meaningful commitment from Moscow not to hit Ukraine's critical infrastructure, calling the US proposal a 'first de-escalatory step'. The statement followed Trump's claim that both sides agreed not to strike energy infrastructure, a day after he asked Kyiv to stop hitting Russian refineries which, he says, are driving up diesel prices ahead of the midterms.

entry.title: Διεθνείς αγορές: Σε υψηλό 19ετίας η απόδοση του αμερικανικού 10ετούς ομολόγου – Υποχωρούν τα χρηματιστήρια
entry.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.03%, a 19-year high going back to July 2007, amid inflationary pressures ahead of the Fed's two-day meeting, with the German 10-year at 3.55% and the French at 4.53%. Brent rose to 107.57 dollars and WTI to 103.26, while European stock markets fell (Milan -1.35%) on the combination of expensive oil, high yields and a tech sell-off.

entry.title: «Η AI θα μπορούσε να σκοτώσει όλους τους ανθρώπους» – Νέα προειδοποίηση από επιστήμονα
entry.summary: Bilal Chughtai, a former AI safety researcher at Google DeepMind, announced his departure saying 'AI has the potential to kill us all and we may be running out of time'. The warning follows the resignations and statements of Anthropic researchers Jacob Coxon and Evan Hubinger (over 10% chance of human extinction within a decade) and Amodei's call to slow down backed by Musk and Altman, while Chughtai calls for regulating development at a pace that allows it to be understood.

entry.title: Χρυσοχοΐδης: «Εχουμε στροφή προς τη βία και την Ακροδεξιά – Δεν έρχονται, είναι εδώ»
entry.summary: Michalis Chrysochoidis, speaking on SKAI on the day of Ilias Kasidiaris's release, spoke of a real 'turn towards violence and the far right' that 'is not coming, it is here', citing the Spartans' 5% in western Athens without a single rally and the rise of the AfD in Germany. He declined to prejudge whether Kasidiaris can run, saying judges will decide under the 2023 Voridis law, and was also asked about the Mazonakis case and Alket Rizai.

entry.title: Ασπίδα στα F-35 με drones
entry.summary: The Hellenic Air Force is in talks with two companies for unmanned 'loyal wingman' aircraft (CCA) to escort its F-35s: Boeing's MQ-28 Ghost Bat and Shield AI's X-BAT, still in development. The aim is for the 20 F-35s, arriving at Andravida from 2029 (290 million euros in works), to act as flying command centres with five to six CCAs each, while planning extends to 2045 to avoid mistakes like the Rafale contract that lacked support provisions.

entry.title: Πρωταθλητισμός απαισιοδοξίας
entry.summary: Core inflation rose to 3.5% in August from 2.5% in July, showing price rises spreading into services and broader categories, while the Bank of Greece sees energy inflation of 11% for 2026. Greek consumers expect 5.6% inflation over the next 12 months (2.9% in the eurozone) and 5.5% over three years, a 'championship of pessimism' that, the columnist argues, will not be fixed by cutting the diesel excise duty but by wage increases above prices.

entry.title: Χούθι: Συνεδριάζει εκτάκτως το ΣΑ του ΟΗΕ για το Μπαμπ ελ Μάντεμπ
entry.summary: The UN Security Council is holding an emergency session, at France's request, on the situation in the Bab el-Mandeb strait, where Yemen's Houthis have consolidated control after a lightning offensive, inflicting blows on government forces and the Saudi-led coalition. Yemen and Saudi Arabia are expected to address the meeting, as the strait is a critical passage for Europe-Asia shipping.

entry.title: Νίκος Ανδρουλάκης: Δισ.
entry.summary: Michalis Tsintsinis totals PASOK's costing: 1.27 billion for a 13th public-sector salary, 840 million for one instalment of a 13th pension, 540 million for a new EKAS, 2.65 billion in all plus 200 euros per child, a VAT cut and abolition of deemed income – 'it will give but not take'. The bigger problem is strategy: with cooperation ruled out and a 15-point gap, Androulakis answers 'who, with whom?' with incantations and tautologies.

entry.title: Παραμένει ο στόχος της πρώτης θέσης για το ΠΑΣΟΚ
entry.summary: At the Thessaloniki Fair Nikos Androulakis restated first place as the precondition for political change, with the slogan 'A country with room for all of us' and seven bills for the first six months in government. PASOK invokes its historic reforms (ESY, ASEP, Diavgeia) to prove it can govern, denounces a 'new oligarchic caste' and insists on an autonomous course.

entry.title: «Καμπανάκι» για το χρέος των ΗΠΑ
entry.summary: US public debt has passed 40 trillion dollars, the 30-year bond yield has touched 5.25% (highest since 2004) and the deficit, at 5.8% of GDP, is projected by the CBO to average 6.1% over the next decade. The analysis warns the US is reaching a point of borrowing to pay interest, with debt projected at 150% of GDP between 2040 and 2048.

entry.title: Αποφυλακίστηκε ο Ηλίας Κασιδιάρης – Προανήγγειλε κόμμα
entry.summary: Ilias Kasidiaris was released from Domokos prison after serving his Golden Dawn sentence and, before supporters, declared he is returning 'to the front line of national struggles' with 'a new, strong national party, like those dominating across Europe'. He called the current government 'the most corrupt since 1974' and said the judge is 'the sovereign Greek people', not the politicians demanding he not return to parliament.

entry.title: Ούρσουλα φον ντερ Λάιεν: Τα επτά «κλειδιά» της ετήσιας ομιλίας της
entry.summary: Ursula von der Leyen delivers her sixth State of the Union address tomorrow, with climate taking centre stage after a nightmarish summer and a resilience plan with a common climate scenario due in October. According to Politico, she will address AI's impact on jobs, a 'radical clean-up' of regulation, strengthening Frontex after the Ceuta crisis and possible funding of border fences, while no new probe against China is expected.

entry.title: Ζυγοστάθμιση μετά τη ΔΕΘ
entry.summary: After the Thessaloniki Fair the government is seeking balance: the bitter feud with Antonis Samaras divides Maximos Mansion, with one camp arguing the attacks 'feed' him, while towards Tsipras the prime minister appears 'relaxed' and sees a 'ceiling'. Pressure will focus mainly on PASOK as a 'small SYRIZA', ND distances itself from the Floridis–Georgiadis remarks about 'national danger', and extends a hand to Karamanlis to keep him neutral.

entry.title: ΠΑΣΟΚ: Διμέτωπος μέχρι το τέλος
entry.summary: PASOK is fighting on two fronts against Mitsotakis and Tsipras, seeking to make Androulakis the main pole against the prime minister, with the wiretapping affair, OPEKEPE, private debt and housing as spearheads. Party headquarters admits Mitsotakis spoke convincingly to PASOK's former centrist voters and sees the 'green SYRIZA' label as an attempt to discredit the party.

entry.title: Σαουδική Αραβία: Προειδοποιήσεις για την απειλή επιθέσεων στη Μέκκα
entry.summary: Saudi Arabia issued brief warnings of possible attacks on Mecca, Jeddah and Taif – the first for Mecca since the Middle East war began – which were promptly withdrawn. They followed a series of ballistic missile and drone attacks by the Iran-backed Houthis that injured 13 people in the south of the kingdom.

entry.title: Η μαγεία κοστίζει όσο η ζωή
entry.summary: Takis Theodoropoulos observes that the Kolonaki clinic with its plasmapheresis machine was no secret: it advertised online and at medical conferences as 'quantum medicine', with no colleague asking what that means or why plasmapheresis was done outside a hospital. Beyond patients' desperation, there is a primitive faith in magic that gains prestige because it is expensive – and sometimes proves as expensive as life itself.
